name: InputMask
intro: Put Label, Control, Placeholder, and Input inside Root to guide entry in a fixed format.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns the mask and input value.

props.name: charset
props.description: Defines accepted characters for placeholder positions.

props.name: ids
props.type: { root?: string; content?: string; input?: string }
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Use Root IDs when a label or external control needs a stable input or trigger target.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: Native label. Set htmlFor to the input ID explicitly, or use Field.Label with an enclosing Field.Root.

parts.name: Control
parts.description: Aligns the placeholder guide and input.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Receives the typed value. Field.Root can supply validation state; the mask itself does not validate completeness.
